prospective_design.sample_size_reason: No qualifying pilot; use existing plan-paired-power only with a valid recorded exploratory pilot, never fabricate discordance. Worst-case confirmation exceeds the two-hour design budget.

stopping_rule: Do not start pilot before two independent qualified autonomous captures and all safety gates. Before activation freeze unseen histories, exact treatment/control binaries, leakage exclusions, failure-inclusive paired estimand and full plan. Stop for qualification or resource failure; no replacement of failed trials or best-of retries. If exact power planning exceeds budget, retain NO_GO.
